input.subject: Q2 2026 Manhattan Market Report — median price, inventory & absorption
input.bodyText:
The Q2 2026 Manhattan Market Report is here.

Highlights:
- Median sale price rose 3.1% year-over-year to $1.24M
- Inventory up 8% vs Q2 2025; 6.2 months of supply
- Days on market averaged 92, down from 101
- Luxury (top 10%) median hit $6.8M

Read the full report with borough-by-borough breakdowns online. Reply if you'd like a printable PDF for your clients.

Elliman Research Team
